subject.title: feat(ios): add Listen action speaking assistant messages via gateway TTS

question: Should the iOS Listen action ship as gateway-first `tts.speak` playback with `AVSpeechSynthesizer` fallback once the stacked gateway PR lands, or should this PR wait for a different mobile voice direction?
rationale: The linked feature issue is marked for maintainer/product review and the PR adds a new visible mobile feature depending on a new gateway RPC; code review can find blockers but cannot choose the permanent UX/protocol direction.

options.title: Accept gateway-first Listen after blockers
options.body: Keep this PR open, fix the SwiftFormat failure, require real iOS playback proof, and land it only after the stacked gateway API is accepted.

options.title: Defer the iOS UI
options.body: Keep the gateway API work separate and wait on the broader mobile Listen issue before adding native UI affordances.

options.title: Use an existing voice surface
options.body: Ask the author to redesign around `talk.speak` or `tts.convert`, accepting that this changes the provider/fallback contract described in the issue.

recommendation.title: Accept gateway-first Listen after blockers
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, fix the SwiftFormat failure, require real iOS playback proof, and land it only after the stacked gateway API is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the linked feature direction and has recent merged history on the iOS chat surface touched here.
